landing.title: Find a visual identity before creating content by instinct
landing.subtitle: First working vertical slice: landing, quiz, AI analysis, archetype result, prompt compilation, mock image generation, checkout, and Telegram delivery.
landing.flowTitle: Landing → Quiz → AI Analysis → Archetype → Prompt → Image → Checkout → Telegram
landing.flowBody: This is not a generic AI photo generator. The product combines self-discovery, archetypal direction, and visual packaging into one paid flow.
featureList: Locale-based routing for ru / uk / en / es
AIProvider with Ollama and Mock fallback

cards.identityBody: A focused quiz captures current image, desired positioning, visual preferences, and intended audience impact.
cards.archetypeBody: The result returns an archetype, strengths, blind spots, and a visual plus business direction.
cards.deliveryBody: The MVP does not stop at inspiration: after generation the user proceeds through checkout and a prepared Telegram access flow.

quiz.title: Identity quiz
quiz.subtitle: Five steps to produce a usable signal for the AI analysis layer.

questions.identity: What signal do you currently project most often?
questions.aspiration: Which identity do you want to amplify in the next few months?
questions.visual_preference: Which visual direction feels closest to you?
questions.business_context: In what professional context do you most often show up?
questions.audience_impact: What effect do you want to create for your audience?

result.title: Archetype result
result.subtitle: The AI layer maps quiz answers into a clear archetypal direction.
result.emptyBody: Start with the questionnaire so the service has enough signal to produce an analysis.

generate.title: Prompt compilation and image concept
generate.subtitle: Compile a prompt from the AI analysis and archetype content, then render the mock image provider flow.
generate.emptyTitle: There is nothing to generate yet
generate.emptyBody: A compiled prompt needs a completed analysis first.
generate.subject: Subject

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.subtitle: One product, one payment, hosted checkout redirect, and no card collection on our site.
checkout.emptyBody: Build the prompt and mock image before moving to checkout.
checkout.productDescription: Archetype analysis, prompt compilation, AI image concept, and Telegram access preparation.

success.title: Payment success
success.subtitle: Telegram delivery is shown only after server-side payment confirmation.
success.thanks: Thank you, your order is in
success.description: After payment confirmation the server prepares Telegram access. In this MVP the success state is simulated through the hosted checkout sandbox route.
success.accessReady: Access is ready. You can open the Telegram invite link.
success.accessPending: A Telegram invite appears only when the order status is paid and the invite link is configured in env.

cancel.title: Payment cancelled
cancel.subtitle: The user can return to checkout without breaking the vertical slice flow.
cancel.body: The payment was cancelled or not completed. You can return to checkout and retry the hosted redirect.
